items.title: Billionaire Palmer Luckey isn’t leaving California over the wealth tax
items.summary: "It's causing a lot of people to run who I don't want to be running," native Californian Palmer Luckey said. "But I'm planning on staying in California. I'm going to keep fighting it."
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop
items.summary: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S. and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
items.summary: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
items.summary: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek
